Task sessions: the mean cost per session of the staged programme's min tier over all ten genres (2026-10-26, token-benchmark run 43, 20 tasks a configuration: $0.109, $0.173, $0.022 and $0.025 for Sonnet, Sonnet with the plugin, Haiku and Haiku with the plugin), rounded up; the arcade-only pilot's medians plus a quarter, used before, came out 15% under that run.
